terminal.label: Terminal executable
terminal.description: Terminal of your choice, e.g. kitty, foot, alacritty or an absolute executable path. Do not include arguments here.

terminal_args.label: Terminal arguments
terminal_args.description: Optional arguments, one list item per argument. Used for Terminal, Packages and Task Manager. No shell expansion.

terminal_exec_args.label: Run-program arguments
terminal_exec_args.description: Arguments before the program for Packages and Task Manager: -e for Kitty/foot/Alacritty, -- for GNOME Terminal, or an empty list if none are needed.

aur_helper.label: AUR helper executable
aur_helper.description: Your choice of helper: paru, yay or an executable path. Must support -S --needed --aur, -Ssa --color never and -Syu. No arguments or shell aliases.
